name: mcp-builder
tagline_zh: 别让 AI 只会聊天——教它亲手造出能调 API 的 MCP 服务器。Python 或 Node 都行。
tagline_en: Stop chatting, start building: craft MCP servers that call real APIs. Python or Node, zero to working, with.
desc_en: Guide for creating high-quality MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that enable LLMs to interact with external services through well-designed tools. Use when building MCP servers to integrate external APIs or services, whether in Python (FastMCP) or Node/TypeScript (MCP SDK).
why_zh: 不止给模板，而是拆解设计决策：何时用工具、如何命名、怎样处理错误，让服务器真正好用而非能跑。
why_en: Not just templates—it explains design choices: tool naming, error handling, and when to use tools, so servers are usable, not.
